business.description: The Company is involved in the business of trading textiles.

outlook.statement: The management remains optimistic about the future prospects of the Company and is committed to pursuing suitable opportunities for business expansion and sustainable growth.

The year 2025-26 was a challenging year from business perspective Meager domestic demand growth, increased imports and volatile raw material prices put increased pressure on margins, with crude oil prices and petrochemicals prices having stabilized and tight situation in cotton supplies the demand should improve the current year.
